title: The Silent Alarm
briefing: The vault was emptied without a sound. Two witnesses each give you an either-or, and neither settles anything alone. Combine them.

atoms.W: The guard has a new watch
atoms.F: There are fingerprints on the alarm panel

statements.speaker: Engineer
statements.text: Nobody empties that vault quietly unless the alarm was switched off or the door was forced.

statements.speaker: Manager
statements.text: Only staff know the code. Either the alarm was not switched off, or it was an inside job.

clues.text: The guard is wearing an expensive new watch.
The door and its lock are untouched: the vault door was not forced.
There are fingerprints on the alarm panel.

tip: Resolution joins two either-or statements: from "P or Q" and "not P, or R" you may conclude "Q or R".
